rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion to a narrow, text-and-precedent reconciliation: § 2409a(g) is a mandatory limitations bar but not jurisdictional under the Court’s clear-statement framework post-Kwai Fun Wong, reading Block’s “no jurisdiction” language as pre-modern shorthand. Thomas and/or Alito are likely to write separately to insist Block and sovereign-immunity waiver conditions make the deadline jurisdictional and nonwaivable, with a modest chance of a Barrett/Gorsuch concurrence emphasizing methodology and limits on equitable doctrines.
